The '''Red Sin Chimaera Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Red Sin Chimaera]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] quadrant.

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] could be found lurking inside the cover of the Red Sin Chimaera Nebula. They would wait silently, striking at the last moment in hopes of a successful kill. For this reason, many thought of the Death Watch as animals, feasting upon the helpless to survive.
